exposure: Ultrasound-guided laparoscopic repair of cesarean scar defect
cohort: A 35-year-old, gravida 2, para 1 woman with a previous cesarean section, presenting at 10 weeks and 3 days gestational age with complete uterine dehiscence.
finding: Ultrasound-guided laparoscopic repair was possible, safe, and effective in this patient, demonstrating a restoration of approximately 8 mm of myometrial thickness across the cesarean scar defect on antenatal follow-up and leading to a term live birth.
mod_finding: The patient, having a previous cesarean section, underwent repair of a cesarean scar defect and subsequently had a term live birth via cesarean section.
gest_age: Presented at 10 weeks and 3 days gestational age, intervention at 11 weeks and 3 days gestational age, with an outcome of term live birth.
